name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Either Zwischenzug goes with Anastasia's or Back-rank goes with Pirc.
Between Nadia and Skewer, one goes with Benoni and the other with Caro-Kann.
Skewer goes with none of Magnus, Nadia, or Benoni.
Nadia goes with Pin if and only if Back-rank goes with Pin.
Zwischenzug goes with at most one of Nadia, Benoni, and Anastasia's.
